summary: Add an internal immutable Quick access delivery engine

replay.detail: No stored claims, membership winners or history are rewritten.

schema.detail: Existing arrangement wire and stored contracts are unchanged.

rules.detail: Existing ownership, lifecycle and coordinated reader-readiness requirements remain.

compatibility.detail: This additive internal engine is not exposed as a public follow API. Existing clients and server contracts are unchanged.

manual.detail: No application controls or active client writes are added. A consuming follow integration must retain the engine and explicitly check an unconfirmed original request.

recovery.detail: Only a completed receipt settles a repeated check. A replay refusal cannot prove the original attempt unapplied. Recovery state is in-memory only and is lost when the follow closes or the process exits; this does not provide a durable outbox. A safe canonical create conflict, including on explicit create replay, validates the reserved live owner/v2 identity; failed validation retains an explicit GET-only recovery step without repeating CREATE. This satisfies the shared-container precondition without proving our CREATE applied. Applied-unknown or replay-unsafe responses cannot adopt. Incompatible validation stays locked with an explicit reason and never recreates the reserved identity.
